program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j, true)
h2_1 = rightmost(h1_1@i & !is_bos@j & h1_1@j, !is_bos@j & h1_1@j)
h3_1 = rightmost(h2_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_b@j & h2_1@j, !is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j & h2_1@j)
h4_1 = rightmost(h2_1@i & h3_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_b@j & h1_1@j, !is_bos@j & !is_b@j)
h6_1 = rightmost(h4_1@i & !is_bos@j & h1_1@j, !is_bos@j)
h7_1 = rightmost(h6_1@i & !is_bos@j & h1_1@j, !is_bos@j & !h2_1@j)
accept = !h4_1 & !h7_1

output accept
